name: Elaine Deretha Simons (Rhinehart)
notable_stories: Irma remembered Elaine as kind, very talented and always the life of the party.
milestones: Buried: Elaine's graveside service was at Desert Lawn Memorial Park in Kennewick on 19 August 2011.
education: Elaine was an elementary school student of Amy Kulp and Alice Burk and was remembered as an excellent student.
locations: Desert Lawn Memorial Park, Kennewick, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Sister of Beryl Simons Adams; married Les Rhinehart.
A funeral service for Elaine was held 17 August 2011 at Holman, Hankins, Bowker & Waud Funeral Home in Oregon City. [Family research emails, email 27]
CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Added her later husband, William "Bill" Upham of Gladstone, Oregon, named in Irma's note about her services. [Family research emails, email 27]
